other_conditions: The applicant must have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months
The registration must be renewed annually
The worker must have an active membership with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The worker must be registered under the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The disability must be caused by an accident or an illness
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹500, plus a lump‑sum ₹50,000 for disability >50% or ₹25,000 for disability ≤50%.
